entries.name: AI
entries.description: Integrate Railway with AI assistants using plugins, connectors, Agent Skills, and the Railway MCP Server.

entries.name: Railway Agent
entries.description: Chat with the Railway Agent to manage services, diagnose failures, and ship fixes directly from the Railway dashboard.

entries.name: Agent Connectors
entries.description: Connect Notion, Linear, Sentry, or your own MCP server to Railway's agent, then attach them as context in dashboard chat and dev.new.

entries.name: Cloud agents
entries.description: Run Claude Code, Codex, or Grok CLI on a persistent Railway virtual machine. Hand off tasks, manage sessions from the terminal or dashboard, and reconnect with your work still in place.

entries.name: Agent skills
entries.description: Agent skills for interacting with Railway directly from your AI coding assistant.

entries.name: MCP server
entries.description: Connect AI coding agents to Railway through Local MCP or Remote MCP.

entries.name: Agent integrations
entries.description: Bring the Railway Agent into your team chat — mention @Railway in Slack or Discord to work with your projects from the conversation.

entries.name: Slack
entries.description: Install the Railway Agent in your Slack workspace and work with your projects from chat.

entries.name: Discord
entries.description: Install the Railway Agent in your Discord server and work with your projects from chat.

entries.name: Plugins and connectors
entries.description: Choose a Railway integration for ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Claude Code, Grok Build, or Cursor.

entries.name: ChatGPT plugin
entries.description: Install the Railway plugin for ChatGPT to deploy and manage Railway infrastructure through the hosted Railway MCP server.

entries.name: Codex plugin
entries.description: Install the Railway plugin for OpenAI Codex to deploy and manage Railway infrastructure with Agent Skills and hosted MCP.

entries.name: Claude connector
entries.description: Connect Railway to Claude through OAuth and Railway's hosted MCP server.

entries.name: Claude Code plugin
entries.description: Install the Railway plugin for Claude Code to manage your infrastructure with natural language.

entries.name: Grok Build plugin
entries.description: Install the Railway plugin for Grok Build from xAI's official plugin marketplace.

entries.name: Cursor plugin
entries.description: Install the Railway plugin for Cursor to manage Railway infrastructure with Agent Skills and hosted MCP.
